reason: Go 1.26 time-budget shutdown can incorrectly return context deadline exceeded; use execution budgets without suppressing or retrying failures
calibration: Maximum observed executions in the prior successful 5-second CI run and later run through ftrace; round upward to 1000, or 10 for slow targets. New regex targets calibrated from local paged plugin fuzzing. Count budgets specify inputs, not deterministic generated corpus contents. make_fuzz: Twice the CI execution count for matching targets; additional local-only targets retain their existing timed budgets until calibrated. All targets retained.
limitations: Counts are a regression workload, not exhaustive fuzz coverage. Wall time varies by host and corpus. Actual crashes, seed failures and test errors remain fatal.
